title: add onboard linter and automated compatibility tagging for new model versions
description: This PR introduces a lightweight onboarding linter and an automated compatibility-tagging hook for model registry submissions. Motivation: onboarding iterations revealed frequent metadata inconsistencies (schema drift) and unclear compatibility between quantized/float variants of the same model. The change bundles three complementary pieces: 1) a CLI 'redwood model onboard --lint' mode that validates metadata, profiles, and required artifacts; 2) a server-side hook that runs on PRs to compute compatibility fingerprints across new model artifacts and auto-apply tags like 'compat:kvcache-stable' or 'compat:requires-shard'; and 3) a changelog templating helper that emits a structured release note fragment when a model version is promoted. The description includes a brief checklist of behaviour: - lint rejects missing required fields (architecture, families, sequence_length_profile) - compatibility hook runs lightweight perf microbenchmarks (cold start, kv cache warm) on a small sample to decide tagging - changelog helper generates a YAML fragment stored in .model_releases/ for later aggregation The CLI and hooks are opt-in for new model owners via metadata flag 'onboard.automation: enabled'. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and opt-out path.
author: Asha Patel

diff_snippets:
--- a/model-registry/cli/onboard.py
+++ b/model-registry/cli/onboard.py
@@ -12,6 +12,18 @@
+def lint_manifest(manifest):
+    missing = []
+    for f in REQUIRED_FIELDS_V2:
+        if f not in manifest:
+            missing.append(f)
+    if missing:
+        raise ValidationError(f'Missing fields: {missing}')
--- a/model-registry/hooks/compatibility_hook.py
+++ b/model-registry/hooks/compatibility_hook.py
@@ -1,6 +1,22 @@
+def compute_compat_tags(artifacts):
+    results = run_sample_perf(artifacts, warm_kv=True, sequences=[16,128])
+    tags = []
+    if results['kv_hit_latency_p95'] < 20:
+        tags.append('compat:kvcache-stable')
+    if results['requires_shard']:
+        tags.append('compat:requires-shard')
+    return tags
review_comments: Diego: Nice work — can we make the perf runner budget-aware? Some customers have limited CI quotas.

Mina: Schema change looks fine, but please add a migration note for existing manifests.
Author (Asha): Migration note added to docs and a small compat shim that accepts old-key 'seq_profile' mapping to 'sequence_length_profile'.
Liam: please add metrics for hook runtime and failure counts so SRE can alert on noisy runs.
Author (Asha): Added observability plumbing and an alert rule with a 5% failure threshold.
release_notes: Model registry: onboarding linter - rejects incomplete manifests and enforces metadata v2 schema.
Compatibility tagging: automated, opt-in hook that emits tags based on lightweight perf probes.
Changelog helper: produces release fragments for aggregated model release notes.
Opt-in: enabled by adding 'onboard.automation: enabled' to model metadata.
testing_and_rollout: Canary: enabled for new model owners only for 2 weeks; existing models opt-out by default.
Monitoring: compatibility_hook runtime and failure metrics added to the registry dashboard.
Rollback: hook failures are non-blocking in first 48h; after that CI enforces lint by default.
